integrity_statement: Proof uses directly verified constructive neighbourhood clauses and classical two-row Jacobi--Trudi enumeration. Reproducible standard-library checker accompanies the proof. Historical priority is not independently certified; independent mathematical audit is not performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for fixed finite nonempty intuitionistic chains and nonempty families of nonempty neighbourhoods; persistent valuations and equality of both modal operations on all upsets. Counting is for observational classes, not raw frames. The general theorem is symbolic; exhaustive raw-frame testing stops at two worlds.
title: Catalan census and relational collapse of finite-chain constructive neighbourhood modalities
